name: "Shooting Star" Turkey & Avocado Mini Sandwiches with Honey-Mustard Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Using a 3 ½-inch star cookie cutter, cut bread into star shapes. Divide between two baking sheet pans, arranging stars in a single layer.
Working in batches, place baking sheets in the oven and toast, flipping halfway through, until stars are lightly golden, 2-3 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, mustard, and honey in a small bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp yellow mustard
1 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Place on a plate.
Wash and dry alfalfa sprouts. Add to the plate with the avocado and set aside.
Arrange half of the stars on a flat surface and spread with honey-mustard mayo. (Reserve remaining stars for the next step.)
Fold turkey slices into quarters and layer on top of the mayo. Top with an avocado slice and a small handful of sprouts. Close sandwiches with remaining stars and secure with a toothpick.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (8 oz) pkg oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: Arrange sandwiches on a platter and enjoy!
